name: Wakemate
description:
WakeMate makes personalized alarm clocks that sync with both a user's body and their cell phone, enabling the iPhone alarm system to sound at the end of a REM cycle.

The application/ wristband system also provides a full sleep analysis on their Analytics Platform.

The WakeMate uses a science called actigraphy to analyze your sleep. Actigraphy uses an actigraph (the WakeMate unit) placed on a subjectâ€™s wrist to monitor the motion. The motion data is then analyzed to determine sleep patterns and circadian rhythms of the subject.

WakeMate was funded by the startup incubator Y Combinator.

name: Mirabelle

founders.name: Dimittri Choudhury
founders.bio: Two years ago, I moved from a village in the South of France to Paris. I studied CS and economics. I started building my first startup with Alex and we scaled it to 100k+ users in 6 months. Funny cause it was the Duolingo for finding schools but it made us drop out. We're building Mirabelle (YC W26), your robot chef, to give people back their health and time.

founders.name: Alexandre Klobb
founders.bio: I started freelancing at 15 doing web scraping, then quickly became a full-stack developer and later an AI engineer training ML and deep learning models. I dropped out of computer science school to co-found Meoria, a career-guidance app that helped over 100,000 French students navigate Parcoursup. Now we're building Mirabelle (YC W26), your robot chef, to give people back their health and time.
